title: Bulk DNA Extraction
author: Reyka Jayasinghe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bsnhndb6

steps.title: Tissue lysis
steps.instruction: Cut ~5 mg tissue, place in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 180 µL Buffer ATL and 20 µL proteinase K, vortex, then incubate at 56 °C until completely lysed (1–3 h).

substeps.instruction: Cut ~5 mg tissue and place in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 180 µL Buffer ATL and 20 µL proteinase K.
Mix by vortexing.
Incubate at 56 °C until lysed (1–3 h).

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNase (100 mg/mL) and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNase (100 mg/mL).
Incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer AL and vortex for 15 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer AL.
Vortex for 15 s.

steps.title: Heat incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 70 °C for 10 min, then briefly centrifuge to remove drops from the lid.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 70 °C for 10 min.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the lid.

steps.title: Ethanol addition
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (96–100 %), vortex for 15 seconds, and briefly centrifuge to remove drops from the lid.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (96–100 %).
Vortex for 15 s.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the lid.

steps.title: Load onto spin column
steps.instruction: Pipet the mixture onto the QIAamp Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature, then discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipet mixture onto QIAamp Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature, and discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place column in new 2 mL collection tube and add 500 µL Buffer AW1.
Centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 3 min at room temperature, and discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place column in new 2 mL collection tube and add 500 µL Buffer AW2.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 3 min at room temperature.
Discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Dry spin
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 1 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Place column in new 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at full speed for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: First DNA elution
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 50 µL DNase‑free water, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Transfer column to new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 µL DNase‑free water.
Incubate 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second DNA elution
steps.instruction: Repeat step 10 using a further 50 µL DNase‑free water.
